content:
Local creators and neighbors across Nuevo Laredo have finished setting up a Halloween "Recorrido del Terror" — a trail of decorated facades, themed houses, and walk-through attractions open for family visits ahead of October 31, according to Central de Noticias Tamaulipas.

Free outdoor displays open to the public include "La Guarida de Pennywise," recreating the IT character's sewer at Paseo Loma Real and Avenida Tecnológico; a vintage-circus-themed home facade on Río Santiago in Colonia Guerrero; a Stranger Things-themed display by designer Delia Garza at Andador 9, No. 12 in Colonia ISSSTE, near San Judas Tadeo church; and themed installations in Centro (Mina and Leandro Valle), Viveros (Cuauhtémoc 1624), and Fundadores (Lago del Norte, between Avenida Tecnológico and Privada Laguna del Norte).

Guided walk-through attractions include the Laberinto del Terror at Gutiérrez 5517 in Colonia Hidalgo, open Fridays and Saturdays from 8 to 10 p.m.; a themed house at Gutiérrez 4809 in Colonia Hidalgo with a 40-peso recovery fee; the White Dental Care haunted house at Gutiérrez 2807 in Centro, with animatronics and costumed staff Thursday through Sunday from 7 p.m. to midnight, with an admission cost; and a candy giveaway and most-creative-costume contest at Miguel Trillo 616 in Colonia Pancho Villa on Saturday, October 31.

Organizers asked visitors to keep the routes orderly, respect private property, and follow traffic and road-safety guidance during the festivities.

Sources:

  • Central de Noticias Tamaulipas, "Creadores y vecinos de Nuevo Laredo instalan el 'Recorrido del Terror' con motivo de las festividades de Halloween," October 30, 2026
